_comment: Reviewed, explicit release definitions. A scope lists exactly the migrations a release applies, their pinned SHA-256, what must already be applied, what must never be present, and the registered postflight verifier. The release workflow can only run scopes defined here; adding a scope or changing a pin needs a reviewed change (CODEOWNERS) and a matching workflow choice, verifier and tests.

D-I.description: Course Builder D, Learning Media E/H, global Question Bank scope F, activity-progress guard G, D03 Stage 1 foundation I

J.description: D03 Stage 2: one final submission per attempt, legacy-grade visibility policy A, reconstruction of overwritten attempts

K-L.description: School authoring/publishing capabilities (K) and the restricted runtime role (L, hosted-compatible revision); requires D-J applied. Migration M (PUBLIC TEMP revocation) is staged and deliberately NOT part of this release.
K-L.productionStatus: READY for the approval-gated Production Database Release only after the reviewed hosted read-only evidence, the restore rehearsal and the independent review (attached to the unblocking PR); apply still requires the production-database-apply reviewer approval
K-L.residualRisk: PUBLIC keeps the database TEMP privilege (the runtime role can create session-local temporary tables) until scope M is released; the owner must accept this in writing

M.description: Revocation of the PUBLIC TEMP privilege (staged migration M); requires D-L applied. Not selectable by the release workflow until a reviewed change moves M into the manifest and extends its platform-role allowlist.
M.productionStatus: BLOCKED until hosted Supabase platform-role compatibility (including pgbouncer, supabase_etl_admin, supabase_privileged_role, supabase_read_only_user, supabase_replication_admin) and recovery behavior are independently verified

N.description: Student temporary password: five additive, defaulted/nullable columns on education_school_user_profiles (dormant first-login gate). No backfill, no constraint/RLS/grant/trigger change; requires D-L applied.
N.productionStatus: READY for the approval-gated Production Database Release; apply requires the production-database-apply reviewer approval. The API is safe to deploy before and after this release while STUDENT_TEMP_PASSWORD_ENABLED is false.

O-Q.description: WF-01 school-admin robot-allocation permission (one idempotent role grant) and LMS academic metadata: canonical BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED level rows, learning_courses.tags/prerequisite_course_ids, learning_assignments difficulty/type/pass score/grading method/objectives, learning_classrooms.self_enrollment_open. Plus Q: Learning Media archive/restore (three nullable columns, one CHECK, one partial index on learning_media_assets; the API build reads them). Additive only; no new table, no backfill, no RLS/grant/trigger/policy change; requires D-L and N applied.
O-Q.productionStatus: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED: needs review of this scope, the rehearsal evidence in docs/acceptance/RELEASE_READINESS.md and the production-database-apply reviewer approval. Apply BEFORE deploying the API that reads the new columns (O-P academic metadata and Q archive columns: the media library and student media URLs query archived_at); the previous API is unaffected by it.

S.description: Classroom Lab Session (migration S): new table classroom_lab_sessions (RLS, one backend policy, runtime SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE) with a partial unique index (one open reservation per robot) and two plain indexes; learning_classroom_robot_allocations UNIQUE(classroom_id) is replaced by UNIQUE(classroom_id, robot_id) (many-to-many allocation); permission education.lab_session.manage for the instructor role. No backfill, no row is rewritten or deleted; requires D-L, N and O-Q applied.
S.productionStatus: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED: apply ONLY after the Lab-Session-aware API (PR #243 or later; it tolerates both schemas) is deployed - the pre-Lab-Session API (f0b3d87 and older) cannot run on the new schema (its allocation upsert fails with 42P10). Needs the production-database-apply reviewer approval and a verified backup. After it is applied no pre-Lab-Session image may be redeployed (the rollback-guard job enforces this).

T-U.description: Migration T (rubric achievement levels: learning_rubric_criteria.descriptors jsonb NULL with a four-element CHECK, learning_assessment_scores.level smallint NULL with a 0..4 CHECK) and migration U (staff first-login password state: public.users.password_change_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, password_changed_at, temporary_password_expires_at). Additive only: no table, policy, trigger or function is created, no backfill, no row is rewritten, nobody is restricted by the release. Requires D-L, N, O-Q and S applied.
T-U.productionStatus: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED: needs the production-database-apply reviewer approval and a verified backup. Compatible in either order with the API: an API that does not know the columns ignores them (explicit column lists); the API reads the U columns only while STAFF_TEMP_PASSWORD_ENABLED=true and the T columns only for assignments that carry descriptors or levels. Enable the flag only after this scope is applied and verified. Rollback = drop the five columns and two CHECK constraints (see each SQL header); it loses only descriptors, recorded levels and pending first-login state.
